claim: Determine whether the unchanged R-005 world can complete its bound ordinary-travel route while preserving the player, ecology actors, scheduler inputs, lifecycle gates, and destination.
material_proof: A fresh zero-credit run separates player/observer interruption handling from production bandit state. It records the selected wait and travel danger modes and every handled prompt, reaches or fails to reach the destination through native travel, and audits whether the bandit route, actor identities, scheduler inputs, or ecology state changed. Only a separate intervention-free run may qualify the natural route.
material_contradiction: source, executable, world, player, ecology actor, scheduler, lifecycle, or destination binding drifts
the run claims natural-route credit after a creature zap or ecology-changing intervention
a handled prompt is absent from the bound receipts
the evidence cannot distinguish player travel interruption from production bandit behavior
cleanup or immutable journal integrity fails
already_accepted_evidence: Five coordinate-planning attempts reached different visible hostile prompts without answering them; those runs preserve honest zero-credit prompt and cleanup evidence but do not show that the monsters affected production bandit path calculation.
R-021 already provides an exact-identity, zero-credit creature HP intervention with bound before/after state and cleanup for a diagnostic comparison.
Native travel now records hostile boundaries and supports explicit stop, classified, and permissive danger handling without changing the default.
current_uncertainty: It is unknown whether the repeated prompts block only the uncloaked player's auto-walk or also affect the production-owned bandit ecology route.
forbidden_shortcuts: treating observer visibility, prompt text, or coordinate avoidance as evidence of bandit route choice
promoting a zap, debug mutation, replay, rollback, replacement identity, or fixture edit into natural-route or certification credit
concealing a handled prompt, contradiction, binding drift, or cleanup failure
claiming R-005 certification or Windows-feel credit from qualification
honest_stop_conditions: finish when cited evidence distinguishes the player interruption path from production bandit behavior and a separate intervention-free run either reaches the destination or proves the remaining natural-route contradiction
finish inconclusive when the authoritative observations cannot distinguish those owners after reasonable in-scope tool or scenario repair
stop for a real binding, external-authority, unavailable-capability, irreversible-risk, or materially different owner-outcome boundary
